authorized_scope: M3 small-model measurement only; M4, M5, B0-H and all formal policy training remain unauthorized

collection.formal_selection: first 60 successful expert_candidate_pool episodes in frozen candidate order
collection.test_visibility: collection writes and hashes the sealed test files, but tuning and power-audit commands reject test paths; test can be read only after the final configuration/checkpoint manifest is hashed

compact_rgb.source: the exact current 480x640 uint8 fixed RGB observation rendered online by RoboFactory
compact_rgb.transform: non-overlapping 8x8 area mean followed by round-to-nearest uint8
compact_rgb.reason: deterministic preprocessing of legal RGB keeps the 360-episode Measurement corpus auditable without storing another roughly 150 GiB of raw frames

sample_protocol.window_selection: uniform integer quantiles over every valid target index; independent of labels and outcomes
sample_protocol.agent_view: one row per robot; shared weights predict that robot's own future action; no explicit agent-slot ID
sample_protocol.ambiguity_rule: drop a window when its current oracle label is invalid or ambiguous; never replace the episode

legal_feature_encoder.task_text: 64-value deterministic UTF-8 byte sequence encoding of canonical task text; no task ID
legal_feature_encoder.current_rgb: 6x8 RGB area means from current compact global and matching-agent views
legal_feature_encoder.history_rgb: 3x4 RGB area means from each of the preceding 15 compact global and matching-agent views
legal_feature_encoder.qpos: 16-step own qpos history, padded only by the earliest legal observation
legal_feature_encoder.action_history: 16-step lag-one own commanded-action history with causal zero padding
legal_feature_encoder.e0_mask: same fixed-width tensor and parameter count, but all pre-current RGB/qpos and action-history values are zero
legal_feature_encoder.place_food_local_fallback: global compact RGB, matching the frozen input contract

social_feature_encoder.encoding: signed SHA256 feature hashing of named, past-causal oracle leaves plus direct finite numeric values; fitted train-only mean/std normalization
T: peer membership in current contact/grasp/controller lists
social_feature_encoder.deployment_hat: one shared legal-input social predictor is episode-cross-fitted in three folds on train; a final train-only predictor supplies tune and sealed-test P_hat/T_hat/B_hat

controls.HC: full legal history plus an input-independent deterministic noise social token
controls.label_shuffled: PTB oracle vectors permuted at episode level within task and split using the frozen dataset-sampler seed
controls.time_phase_only: elapsed control step divided by the public task time limit and four fixed elapsed bins; never divided by realized episode length

action_probe.architecture: LayerNorm(input) -> Linear(input,256) -> SiLU -> Linear(256,256) -> SiLU -> Linear(256,800)
action_probe.output: 100 future 8D own-action steps; masked training loss; first 16 steps are primary
action_probe.selection_metric: HC tune macro episode NRMSE only
action_probe.randomness: one frozen common initialization seed and one frozen dataset-sampler seed; deterministic CUDA algorithms where supported

metric.normalization: train-only per-task per-action-dimension mean/std; std floor 1e-3
metric.primary: episode NRMSE over all eligible robots, windows, first 16 future steps and 8 action dimensions
metric.effect: (HC episode NRMSE - condition episode NRMSE) / HC episode NRMSE; positive is better

power_audit.timing: after tuning and checkpoint hashing, before unsealing test
power_audit.method: normal approximation using task-stratified paired episode-effect variance with 12 future test episodes per task

statistics.bootstrap: 10000 task-stratified paired episode resamples, 95% percentile CI
statistics.source_test: 10000 paired episode sign-flip permutations on task-macro gain

acceptance.overlap_report: for every pair among P/T/B, report both single-source gain and its conditional increment over the other source
acceptance.negative_control_policy: report label-shuffled and time/phase-only gains and CIs; they cannot replace HC or rescue a source
acceptance.decision_scope: M3 may pass or fail P, T and B independently; it never authorizes B0-H or formal model training
